mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% consistently signals accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate sustained liquidity support.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 9.5% indicates severe labor market weakness that suppresses consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 9.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) and low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 2.0%) create a stable macro environment that supports equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and CPIAUCSL < 2.0% fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) triggers anticipated Federal Reserve tightening, increasing equity discount rates and reducing valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 550,000 units (HOUST < 550) signal weak residential construction, reducing consumer confidence and corporate revenue expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST is below 550.

mechanism_narrative: Robust industrial production (INDPRO > 100) indicates strong manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 100.

mechanism_narrative: Strong job growth (PAYEMS > 100,000) combined with low unemployment (UNRATE < 5.0%) creates a tight labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of PAYEMS > 100000 and UNRATE < 5.0% fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: High real GDP (GDPC1 > 12000) indicates late-cycle economic maturity where recession risks increase and policy tightening becomes imminent, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 exceeds 12000.
